newsitem.title: JAPAN: TOCOM palladium futures surge by daily limit.
newsitem.headline: TOCOM palladium futures surge by daily limit.

text.p: Yen-based June, August and October palladium futures surged by their 22 yen per gram daily limit at the opening, buoyed by gains in the New York market overnight and the yen's weakness against the dollar, traders said.
The benchmark February palladium futures contract was quoted 17 yen per gram higher at 606 yen in early Tokyo trade, down from 610 yen at the opening.
Traders attributed the rise to the further delay in Russian platinum group exports to Japan.
Buying by trade houses emerged from the outset, but private investors were wary of taking positions amid a feeling that prices were too high.
"Palladium futures are likely to be higher for most of the day," an analyst at a commodity broker said, adding that currency rates would be key for the market.
